title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns
excerpt: Nvidia announces the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang following reports of two affairs, including one involving an alleged Chinese spy.
body_html:
Nvidia has announced that Jensen Huang has stepped down from his position as CEO. The leadership change follows recent reports detailing two affairs, which reportedly involved a direct report and an individual alleged to be a Chinese spy.

The situation developed rapidly after initial reports highlighted a close connection between Huang and the suspected spy, leading to varied reactions from figures across the technology industry regarding the sudden departure.
